summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric services company, reporting minutes of its Board of Directors meeting on May 21, 2026. The board approved two items: (1) an infrastructure assignment agreement with Eletronet for dark fiber optic pairs worth R$125 million over 240 months, and (2) migration of its ADR program from Level 2 to sponsored Level 1. Neither item constitutes a transformative special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The ADR migration is a routine administrative change, and the infrastructure agreement is an ordinary operational contract. No special-situation event is triggered.
